optionalSteps.name: ux_interaction_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews interaction flows, user journeys, state transitions, and usability of proposed design.
optionalSteps.triggers: New user-facing features, workflow changes, multi-step interactions, or significant UX restructuring.

optionalSteps.name: ui_component_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews visual design patterns, component reuse, layout structure, and design system consistency.
optionalSteps.triggers: Features with UI components, new pages/views, visual layout changes, or design system extensions.

optionalSteps.name: infrastructure_design_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews infrastructure implications: hosting, scaling, resource provisioning, cost, and deployment topology.
optionalSteps.triggers: Changes to deployment architecture, new services/workers, database provisioning, caching layers, or CI/CD pipeline.

optionalSteps.name: data_modeling_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews data model design: schema, relationships, storage patterns, migration paths, and data flow.
optionalSteps.triggers: New database tables/columns, schema migrations, data pipeline changes, or storage strategy changes.

optionalSteps.name: api_design_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews API contract design: endpoints, request/response shapes, versioning, pagination, and error conventions.
optionalSteps.triggers: New or modified API endpoints, webhook contracts, inter-service communication, or public API changes.

optionalSteps.name: security_threat_model
optionalSteps.description: Threat modeling: attack surface analysis, trust boundaries, data classification, and auth/authorization design.
optionalSteps.triggers: Features involving authentication, authorization, user data handling, external integrations, or cryptography.

optionalSteps.name: performance_design_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews performance implications: expected load, latency targets, query patterns, caching strategy, and bottleneck analysis.
optionalSteps.triggers: High-traffic features, database-heavy operations, real-time requirements, or large data processing.

optionalSteps.name: accessibility_design_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews accessibility considerations: keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast, ARIA patterns.
optionalSteps.triggers: User-facing features with interactive elements, forms, dynamic content, or navigation changes.

optionalSteps.name: legal_regulatory_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews legal and regulatory implications: data protection (GDPR/CCPA), terms of service, licensing, and consent flows.
optionalSteps.triggers: Features handling PII, user consent, data retention/deletion, third-party data sharing, or regulated industries.

optionalSteps.name: migration_compatibility_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews migration and backward compatibility: rollback paths, feature flags, data migration safety, and client impact.
optionalSteps.triggers: Breaking changes, schema migrations, API version changes, or deprecations affecting existing users.

optionalSteps.name: cost_analysis_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews operational cost implications: compute, storage, API call volume, third-party service costs, and scaling economics.
optionalSteps.triggers: New external service integrations, storage-intensive features, high-volume API usage, or infrastructure provisioning.

optionalSteps.name: observability_design_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews logging, monitoring, alerting, and debugging design: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and dashboards.
optionalSteps.triggers: New services, background jobs, external integrations, error-prone flows, or SLA-bound features.

optionalSteps.name: security_audit
optionalSteps.description: Reviews code for security vulnerabilities, injection risks, auth flaws, and data exposure.
optionalSteps.triggers: Changes to authentication, authorization, API endpoints, user input processing, data serialization, or cryptography.

optionalSteps.name: soc2_compliance_audit
optionalSteps.description: Thorough SOC2 compliance audit: audit logging, data retention, access controls, encryption.
optionalSteps.triggers: Changes to audit logging, data retention, access controls, encryption, or explicit compliance requirements.

optionalSteps.name: infrastructure_code_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews IaC, deployment scripts, CI/CD changes, container configs, and environment management.
optionalSteps.triggers: Changes to Dockerfiles, CI/CD workflows, Terraform/CDK, environment variables, or deployment scripts.

optionalSteps.name: performance_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews for N+1 queries, blocking I/O, missing indexes, and algorithmic complexity.
optionalSteps.triggers: Database query changes, loop-heavy processing, high-traffic paths, or cache logic.

optionalSteps.name: accessibility_audit
optionalSteps.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard nav, focus, contrast.
optionalSteps.triggers: UI component changes, forms, modals, navigation changes, or dynamic content updates.

optionalSteps.name: api_contract_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews API changes for backward compatibility, error consistency, and client impact.
optionalSteps.triggers: Modified API endpoints, changed request/response schemas, new error codes, or versioning changes.

optionalSteps.name: database_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews schema changes, migration safety, query performance, and data integrity.
optionalSteps.triggers: New/altered tables, migration scripts, complex queries, transaction logic, or foreign key changes.

optionalSteps.name: dependency_audit
optionalSteps.description: Reviews third-party dependencies: known vulnerabilities, license compatibility, and supply chain risk.
optionalSteps.triggers: New package additions, version upgrades, or changes to dependency resolution.

optionalSteps.name: ui_visual_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews visual implementation: design system adherence, responsive layout, theming, spacing/typography consistency.
optionalSteps.triggers: UI component implementation, CSS/style changes, theme modifications, or responsive layout work.

optionalSteps.name: error_handling_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews error handling completeness: exception coverage, user-facing errors, retry logic, and graceful degradation.
optionalSteps.triggers: New error paths, external service calls, user input validation, or changes to error reporting.

optionalSteps.name: internationalization_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews i18n readiness: string externalization, locale handling, date/number formatting, RTL support.
optionalSteps.triggers: User-facing text additions, date/time handling, currency/number formatting, or locale-dependent logic.

optionalSteps.name: privacy_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews data privacy practices: PII handling, data minimization, consent enforcement, anonymization.
optionalSteps.triggers: Changes to user data collection, storage, processing, sharing, or deletion flows.

optionalSteps.name: security_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews security testing adequacy: auth test coverage, authorization boundary tests, injection testing.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included auth, input handling, data exposure, or API security changes.

optionalSteps.name: performance_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews performance testing coverage: load tests, latency benchmarks, resource utilization tests.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included high-traffic paths, database-heavy operations, or performance-sensitive changes.

optionalSteps.name: accessibility_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews accessibility testing completeness: automated a11y scans, keyboard navigation, WCAG checkpoint verification.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included UI changes, interactive components, or navigation modifications.

optionalSteps.name: integration_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews integration and E2E test coverage: external service tests, cross-component flows, failure scenarios.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included external API calls, multi-component interactions, or event-driven flows.

optionalSteps.name: edge_case_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews boundary condition and edge case coverage: null/empty inputs, overflow, concurrency, race conditions.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included input validation, numeric operations, concurrent access, or state machine logic.

optionalSteps.name: regression_risk_review
optionalSteps.description: Assesses regression risk: identifies areas impacted by changes that may lack test coverage.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation touched shared utilities, core abstractions, or widely-referenced modules.

optionalSteps.name: data_integrity_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews data validation and consistency testing: constraint enforcement, referential integrity, migration rollback.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included schema changes, data migration, or data transformation logic.

optionalSteps.name: compliance_test_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews compliance verification testing: audit log tests, data retention verification, consent flow tests.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included compliance-related changes (audit logging, data retention, access controls).

optionalSteps.name: disaster_recovery_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews failure mode testing: service outage handling, data recovery procedures, failover verification.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included infrastructure changes, data storage modifications, or high-availability features.

optionalSteps.name: monitoring_alerting_review
optionalSteps.description: Reviews observability testing: log output verification, metric emission tests, alert threshold validation.
optionalSteps.triggers: Implementation included new logging, metrics, alerting rules, or monitoring integration.
